# goton documentation

> Documentation for goton, the non-custodial launchpad for fixed-supply tokens on Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663) and Arc (chain id 5042). Tokens launch on a bonding curve that graduates into a locked Uniswap v4 pool (Robinhood Chain) or straight into a locked Uniswap v4 pool (Arc).

Every token has a supply of 1,000,000,000 (18 decimals), no mint function and liquidity locked for good. Creators keep 70% (Robinhood Chain) or 80% (Arc) of each token's fees and tax, and can share it with holders, a buyback or a team.
